description: Canonical status line specification shared by Claude Code and Codex CLI. Each client renders the same fields in the same order. A client omits a field when the client does not supply the value.

codex.note: Codex renders the token count as its own segment. Codex omits it when the count is zero.

rules: No repository name, branch name, PR number, model name, or usage value is hard-coded.
No field makes a network call. Every value comes from the client payload or from a local git command.
A field that has no value is dropped together with its separator.

claude.notes: The renderer also forwards the payload to the Orca status line hook so that the Orca integration keeps working.

codex.notes: Codex does not run an arbitrary script for the status line. It renders a fixed item list, so the item ids above are used in the same order. The separator and the field labels are fixed by Codex.

claude.mechanism: ANSI escape codes emitted by the renderer. NO_COLOR turns them off.
claude.gauges: green above 40% left, yellow at 16-40% left, red at 15% left or below

codex.note: Codex takes the colors from the active /theme. Per-field colors are not configurable.
